summary: For a pattern no listed check tool can express, loop-run proposed a home-made test script as a machine rule in a project with no test tool, instead of a coding-agent instruction.
With 6 of 31 findings not acted on, loop-run wrote a fourth proposal to change the reviewer because of the naming and magic-number findings, which are decoys that did not lead to a change.

On a project that was already set up, loop-setup asked what should change and was told one thing, then still walked the user through the first-time questions (log location, where checks run, autonomy, which findings count, schedule) although the existing config answers them.
